name: cs-md-docs
description: Renders the untagged text of a C# /// comment as Markdown on hover, without duplicating anything Roslyn already shows.

virtualWorkspaces.description: Hovers are registered for the file, untitled and notebook-cell schemes, so a workspace opened over a virtual file system gets nothing. Symbol links additionally need the C# language server, which does not run on the web.

csMdDocs.crossFile.description: Resolve the declaration through the C# definition provider, so hovering a call site in another file works. Turn off to only document symbols declared in the file under the cursor.

csMdDocs.definitionTimeoutMs.description: Give up on the definition provider after this long, so a slow language server never stalls the hover.

csMdDocs.skipWhenTagged.description: Suppress this hover entirely when the doc comment contains any XML section tag. Untagged text is already excluded from tagged sections, so this only matters if you want tagged members to be exclusively Roslyn's.

csMdDocs.demoteHeadings.description: Push every Markdown heading down by this many levels. Rust puts '# Examples' at the top level, which in a hover popup is a title larger than the signature beneath it. Set to 0 to render headings as written.

csMdDocs.hoverStyling.description: Compensate for the hover stylesheet, which styles paragraphs, lists, headings, code and rules but leaves blockquotes and tables to the browser default. Adds a themed bar to a quote and padding to table cells, using the only inline markup the hover sanitizer accepts. Off keeps the output portable Markdown and disables HTML in the hover.

csMdDocs.defaultCodeLanguage.description: Language to label a code fence that was written without one, so it is syntax highlighted rather than grey. Applies to a <code> element and to a bare ``` fence. Empty leaves them unlabelled; a value containing anything but letters, digits, +, # or - is ignored.

csMdDocs.symbolLinks.description: Turn a bracket reference such as [`Device.Send`] into a link that jumps to the symbol, resolved through the C# workspace symbol provider. Off renders it as a plain code span.

csMdDocs.heading.description: Markdown prepended to the rendered text, e.g. "**Notes**\n\n". Empty for none.
